engine_note: modelled 'supertrend' on free OHLCV (BTC-USD, 3652 bars, D); a faithful re-implementation of the logic, not the literal Pine on TradingView. archetype inferred via llm (confidence 99%). Pine syntax not verified (no TradingView connected); rigor reflects the strategy logic.
verdict: This is an always-in-market Supertrend reversal swing strategy — medium holding periods, no stops, position rides until the next flip. The decisive failure is D1: in-sample PF 2.54 collapses to OOS PF 0.66 across 36 trades, meaning the strategy actively loses money on unseen data — not marginal degradation but a full edge reversal, the clearest hallmark of curve-fitting. gates.name: Look-ahead bias
gates.detail: no future-data access detected (no lookahead_on, no unguarded MTF read).

gates.name: Repainting
gates.detail: evaluates on confirmed bars (calc_on_every_tick default false).

gates.name: Sufficient sample
gates.detail: 102 trades — enough to draw a conclusion.

dimensions.name: Out-of-sample
dimensions.detail: edge degrades out-of-sample: in-sample PF 2.54 -> OOS PF 0.66 (36 OOS trades) — sign of curve-fitting.

dimensions.name: Overfitting surface
dimensions.detail: 2 tunable inputs vs 102 trades (51 trades/param) — low degrees of freedom.

dimensions.name: Multi-timeframe
dimensions.detail: edge persists on a neighbouring timeframe (240: PF 1.06, W: PF 7.00) — not a single-TF cherry-pick.

dimensions.name: Multi-instrument
dimensions.detail: edge generalizes to another instrument (NASDAQ:QQQ: PF 1.24).

dimensions.name: Inverse-edge / luck
dimensions.detail: the inverse strategy loses (inverse PF 0.55 vs strategy PF 1.83) — the directional edge is real, not coin-flip.

dimensions.name: Cost survival
dimensions.detail: edge mostly survives realistic costs (PF 1.83 -> 1.80, gave back 0.03).

reviews.name: Look-ahead / repaint
reviews.detail: No security()/request.*() calls; strategy() defaults calc_on_every_tick=false, so ta.supertrend and ta.change(dir) are evaluated on confirmed bar-close values only.

reviews.name: Overfitting
reviews.detail: Only two tunable inputs (atrPeriod=10, factor=3.0) — low count, but both are trivially grid-searched; no out-of-sample window is enforced, so reported results likely reflect the optimised pair for the visible history.

reviews.name: Cherry-picking
reviews.detail: No hardcoded date ranges, session filters, or symbol-specific conditionals; the strategy is symbol- and timeframe-agnostic on its face.

reviews.name: Cost & fill realism
reviews.detail: strategy() is declared with no commission_type, commission_value, or slippage arguments, so both default to zero; strategy.entry() fills at next-bar open with no slippage model, overstating net P&L.

reviews.name: Position sizing / risk
reviews.detail: strategy.entry() uses no explicit qty or default_qty_type/default_qty_value, so lot size is platform-default (1 contract); there is no stop-loss — the only exit is the opposing strategy.entry(), meaning losses ride until the next Supertrend flip.

reviews.name: Logic soundness
reviews.detail: ta.change(dir) < 0 correctly detects the dir 1→−1 transition (bullish flip) for Long entry and > 0 detects −1→1 (bearish flip) for Short entry; the always-in-market reversal mechanic is internally consistent with the Supertrend definition.
